dek: A Hong Kong court has acquitted a woman of possessing a weapon when protests were taking place in a neighbouring district in 2019, after she was re-arrested upon returning to the city from Australia earlier this year. Ami Chan was found not guilty of both charges of possessing an offensive weapon and possessing an item
